constraints: If no relation originates from manyField, both one and many return 0, a syntax error (No. 16) is generated, and the OK system variable is set to 0.
Compare the returned one/many values against the Relations theme constants: No relation=0, Structure configuration=1, Manual=2, Automatic=3.

overloadMerges.note: one and many are filled in by the command (out), not in parameters.

params.name: one
params.description: Automatic/manual status of the Many-to-One relation

params.name: many
params.description: Automatic/manual status of the One-to-Many relation
If passed, forces reading the current status of the relation, restricting one/many to values 2 or 3 only; if omitted, one/many may also return 1 (unmodified structure-configured status)

overloadMerges.semanticRole: Reports, in one and many, the automatic/manual status of the many-to-one and one-to-many relations originating from manyField for the current process.
